    """Equation to be evolved.

    This formula is about Coupled dynamics of the second magnetic dipole. Calculate the Angular velocity of the second magnet (dphi/dt) given Angle of the first magnet and Angle of the second magnet

    - Independents:

    return params[0] * np.sin(x0) + params[1] * np.sin(x1) + params[2] * np.cos(x0) + params[3] * np.cos(x1) + params[4] * np.sin(x0 - x1) + params[5] * np.cos(x0 + x1) + params[6] * np.sin(x0) * np.cos(x1) - params[7] * np.cos(x0) * np.sin(x1)
